scope.summary: Implement the CPU procedural render/generate kinds that synthesize pixels from parameters+seed (replace or blend, marked): Clouds (random cloud between two colors, replaces layer data, seeded), Difference Clouds (blends generated clouds in Difference mode, seeded), Fibers (woven fiber from two colors, variance/strength/randomize), Lens Flare (placeable center + lens-type presets), Procedural Texture / formula (user pixel-math formulas, scriptable deterministic generator). Seeded for reproducibility.
acceptance_criteria: Clouds, Difference Clouds, Fibers, Lens Flare, Procedural Texture (formula) implemented; seeded/deterministic
expected_tests: test: seeded Clouds/Difference Clouds/Fibers reproducible; Lens Flare placement; Procedural Texture formula deterministic per inputs

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
